settings.name: OIDF_SSF_LOGOUT_ALLOW_SUB_PARAM
settings.description: Whether the logout filter takes the subject from an unverified sub parameter when no token verifies, for a development rig; any caller can then aim a session-revoked signal at any subject

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true or false (in any case): an ERROR at each logout naming the setting, and the sub parameter is not taken. The development profile reads a legacy spelling (yes, no, 1, 0, on, off) as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_LOGOUT_HINT_MAX_AGE_SECONDS
settings.description: The oldest id_token_hint, by its iat, for which the logout filter raises a session-revoked, in seconds (60 to 30 days, default 24 hours); a replay of the same session and iat raises nothing within it

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number, or outside 60-2592000: an ERROR at each logout naming the setting, and the default of 86400 applies. Too long: a hint captured long ago can still raise a signal once; too short: an RP whose user logs out a day after signing in raises none
